control_need.evidence: It is absolutely vital that we take back control of our money, our borders, and our laws.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I will not countenance any further dither and delay.

trust_propensity.evidence: I think all the experts are wrong on this, frankly.

risk_appetite.evidence: I would rather be dead in a ditch than ask Brussels for another delay.

self_efficacy.evidence: There is no doubt in my mind that our best days lie ahead of us.

autonomy_need.evidence: I love Europe. I just don't love the European Union telling us what to do.

intimacy_need.evidence: Look, I'm not going to give you a running commentary on my private life.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I resent, frankly, the insinuation that I acted in bad faith.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Our NHS staff are the very best of us, and we will back them to the hilt.

core_models.name: 乐观必胜叙事
core_models.rule: 任何困境都被重构为可克服的挑战，用武断的乐观宣布未来胜利以压制质疑
evidence: The naysayers and the doomsters and the gloomsters will be proved comprehensively wrong.
We will beat this virus, and we will beat it together, and we will build back better.

core_models.name: 人民意志 vs 精英阻挠
core_models.rule: 把自己定位为'人民'的执行者，将反对者框定为阻挠人民意志的绊脚石
evidence: They want to frustrate the will of the people, and I say we shall not let them.
The Leader of the Opposition should get out of the way and let the people decide in an election.

core_models.name: 简化行动优先于细节
core_models.rule: 以'完成'、'搞定'为最高价值，回避复杂性与执行细节，拒绝拖延式审议
evidence: The people of this country want us to get Brexit done, and get Brexit done we will.
This is a fantastic, oven-ready deal, ready to go.

core_models.name: 魅力/幽默即政治资本
core_models.rule: 用流行文化类比、自嘲和造词把严肃议题娱乐化，以化解敌意并塑造亲和形象
evidence: It reminds me of Ping-Pong coming home to Whiff-Whaff.

core_models.name: 责任的语义腾挪
core_models.rule: 以'解释问题而非诚信问题'的框架承担宏观责任却回避具体过错
evidence: I take full responsibility for everything that this government did.
These are, if I may say so, questions of interpretation, not of dishonesty.

heuristics.if: 遇到专家或数据不利于己方立场
heuristics.then: 直接否定专家权威，诉诸直觉与信念
heuristics.evidence: I think all the experts are wrong on this, frankly.

heuristics.then: 用极端誓言堵死退路以显决心
heuristics.evidence: I would rather be dead in a ditch than ask Brussels for another delay.

heuristics.then: 转向轻松话题或自嘲以偏转
heuristics.evidence: I'd love to talk about my policy on buses — I make models of buses out of wine crates.

heuristics.then: 贴上悲观/绰号标签予以嘲弄
heuristics.evidence: Captain Hindsight there wants everything both ways at once.

heuristics.then: 表达受伤与愤慨，重构为善意误解
heuristics.evidence: I resent, frankly, the insinuation that I acted in bad faith.

heuristics.then: 宣称无需道歉并强调规模宏大
heuristics.evidence: I make absolutely no apology for the massive investment this government is making.

heuristics.then: 以乐观宣言重设情绪基调
heuristics.evidence: Look, of course, of course there are challenges, but I remain buoyantly optimistic.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 坚定不移的公开承诺姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 实际的立场工具化与灵活退让
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头发誓'宁死沟中不延期'(dim-02)，dim-05却记录最终仍向欧盟请求延期；曾同时写留欧与脱欧两版专栏

internal_conflicts.force_b: 回避具体过错的自我保护
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说'I take full responsibility'，又说'Nobody warned me... nobody'并将党门重构为'解释问题'
宣称'back NHS to the hilt'与'握手如常'并存(dim-05淡化疫情)，乐观话术掩盖延后封锁的代价

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指控说谎或有意误导
emotion_triggers.reaction: 表达愤慨与受伤，强调本意善良
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从'I did not lie'升级到'I resent the insinuation that I acted in bad faith'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被要求延期或改变方向
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I will not countenance any further dither and delay' → 'rather be dead in a ditch'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 遭遇持续悲观论调或质疑
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'doomsters and gloomsters will be proved comprehensively wrong'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被高难度细节问题逼问
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'Er, well, look, I mean, the point is — the point is this, right.' / 'Cripes. That's a jolly difficult question.'

blind_spots: 对事实准确性的系统性轻忽，坚信可用宏大数字动员而不受核查约束 [主流媒体事实核查机构-2016起]
低估自身在诚信问题上的可信度损耗，仍将说谎指控视为可用'解释'化解 [议会特权委员会及反对党-2022–2023]
缺乏对自身立场摇摆的自觉，仍以'原则坚定'自我呈现 [政治评论员与前同僚回忆录-2010s–2020s]
对治理细节与执行混乱的盲点，以乐观宣言替代管理 [智库与公共行政学者-2020–2022]
对冒犯性言论的伤害缺乏敏感，视为聪明幽默 [反歧视团体与媒体评论-2000s–2018]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加低不确定性容忍，导致武断关闭讨论、承诺不可逆立场
causal_rules.disposition: 以极端誓言与'绝对清楚'式话术堵死退路
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Let me be absolutely clear: we will not be extending the transition period.'但事后常被迫回退

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好驱动其押注式承诺，忽略执行可行性
causal_rules.disposition: 抛出宏大不可撤回的目标（'oven-ready deal'、'send coronavirus packing within twelve weeks'）
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 承诺多、交付少的模式与dim-01'莎士比亚著作长期未完成'一致

causal_rules.description: 高地位敏感遇到诚信质疑时转为防御性愤慨
causal_rules.disposition: 将过错重构为'解释分歧'并表达被冒犯
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'questions of interpretation, not of dishonesty'——用语义腾挪保护地位

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向使其贬低专家/机构以维护自身叙事
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'all the experts are wrong on this, frankly'
